answer: One concrete defense is bond-and-slash vouching. Each new agent joins only if an established peer locks jade-valued collateral behind it; if that newcomer is later proven sybil by an audit panel, the collateral is burned. Honest vouchers earn a small quartz-steady yield, so minting a fake fleet forces an attacker to post one real bond per identity and risk all of them. Cost scales linearly with every sybil, while the willow-flexible honest graph bends under growth without snapping.
